business_summary: Cre8 Direct (NingBo) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in design, production, processing, and sale of paper products in North America, Asia, Europe, Oceania, South America, Africa, and China. The company offers eco-friendly products comprising recycled paper, sugar cane paper, bamboo paper, recycled plastics, and other eco-friendly materials; journals and notebooks; planners and calendars; back to school products, including portfolio pocket folders, pencil cases and pouches, composition books, notebooks, sticky notes, and expanding files; office and organization products consisting of storage boxes and bags, file boxes, clipboards, ring binders, document trays, magazine holders, and pen holders; and stationery and gifts, such as notepads, note cubes, thank you notes, boxed notecards, stationery gift sets, pencil pouches, and metal pens. It also provides celebration products comprising gift bags and boxes, and greeting cards; seasonal products consisting of Christmas folded boxes and bags, Christmas wraps and cards, and Christmas tableware; creative essential products, including sketchbooks, painting products, and scratch and velvet art products; and kids activities and game products, such as coloring book, scratch, velvet painting, watercolor, canvas painting, puzzles, and board and card games, as well as scrapbooking and photo albums, paper crafting products, art supplies, party D.I.Y., dated goods, home décor, and children's crafts. It also distributes home fitness equipment, including dumbbell benches, cable machines, weightlifting equipment, and trampolines; and garden and colorful flags, outdoor flags, daily textile products, household items, and other products, as well as sales of furniture and outdoor products and housing rental. It serves retailers and brands. Cre8 Direct (NingBo) Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Ningbo Chenglu Paper Products Manufacturing Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Ningbo, China.
